test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question: **When the City Mayor says, "We are now on high alert in addressing the syndrome”, he means:**

options.text: people are consulting each other in panic
the city administration is concerned about war
the administration understands it’s an urgent health issue
it’s sad for the people who are suffering

solution: The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'the administration understands it’s an urgent health issue.'
